items.author: Jake Harrison
items.content:
Keystone says it will destroy almost 19,000 unshipped hardware wallets after an attacker obtained the key it uses to verify its devices.
First, Keystone took to X on Saturday to confirm a suspected breach of customer shipping information, including “names, contact details, shipping addresses, and order details (items and prices).”
The confirmation came around 18 hours after a customer reported a “social engineering” call in which Keystone order information was used.
While sensitive payment information and wallet keys were not involved, the firm did warn against scammers impersonating its staff and “offering refunds, replacement devices, or ‘fixes’ for your order or address.”
Read more: Ledger says Southeast Asia reseller linked to $86M draining
The company had previously promised that “180 days after your order, your shipping data is permanently deleted,” but the user that initially flagged the potential data breach claims that their device was purchased in 2024.
A later update put the total number of affected records at almost 26,000, limited to purchases made via Shopify on its official site (plus a further 13,000 incomplete purchase records of partial order information).
It also states that another 25,000 records had already been “permanently erased… in accordance with our data retention policy.” However, it concedes that its automated data deletion tool “did not operate reliably… resulting in certain personal information being retained beyond the permitted period.”
Worryingly, the update also included the admission that “the attacker also obtained the WebAuth key we use to verify whether a device is genuine.”
Newly built Keystone wallets will use a new key, with shipping suspended pending the change, and almost 19,000 units of existing un-shipped inventory will be destroyed.
Foundation Passport: botched data migration
Similarly, reports of phishing emails targeting Foundation Passport users circulated on X from early Monday morning. Screenshots show the use of scare tactics regarding a display module, undoubtedly inspired by the recent compromised Ledger devices.
The manufacturer confirmed that the “spam” emails had been sent from its official domain and traced the source to “one or more compromised API keys on Cloudflare.”
Read more: Ledger roasted over $849 device launch after $86M hack
Foundation, too, had previously assured users that customer data is “automatically” deleted after 60 days.
In an update, it clarified that over 20,000 phishing attempts were delivered across its systems, but that they “are still determining” how many users had their personal data exposed.
As to the data deletion within 60 days, it claims that its previous provider WooCommerce did purge order data. However, “during past database migrations,” only the new tables were redacted, while “older copies still contained personal information.” It adds that more recent orders placed via Shopify “may also have been exposed.”
(Dis)honourable mentions
Hardware wallet users have had it rough in recent weeks, to put it lightly.
While cold storage has always been seen as the safest option for crypto users to store their assets, a series of security incidents has seen hefty losses as well as data leaks that will have users looking over their shoulder for years to come.
Between them, Ledger’s spyware scandal and Coldcard’s seed generation bug led to over $200 million in losses.
Read more: Trezor’s summer of hacks continues with Brevo email breach
Other recent leaks have come from repeat offender Ledger, its primary competitor, Trezor, and SafePal.
Fresh off the back of devastating user losses, Coldcard had its X profile compromised to publish a phishing scam to its 67,000 followers earlier this month.
While not a data leak, per sé, it was especially embarrassing coming just two days after an attempt to capitalize on Ledger’s bad press with a ballsy tweet about its wallet’s clear case.

items.content:
NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.
The National Basketball Association has named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction market exchanges and signed an information-sharing agreement with the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) aimed at protecting the integrity of basketball-related markets.
According to Monday’s announcement, the agreements will give Kalshi and Polymarket access to official NBA data supplied by Sportradar, the league’s designated data distribution partner, for settling authorized markets. Both platforms will have rights to use NBA intellectual property and conduct promotional activities in the United States.
The partnerships include integrity safeguards, prohibiting NBA and team personnel from trading NBA event contracts and requiring cooperation on suspicious trading investigations.
Beyond the two exchanges, the NBA expanded its existing agreement with DraftKings to cover prediction markets and said it expects to announce similar arrangements with other industry operators in the coming weeks.
In a separate announcement, CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the agreement with the NBA would strengthen information sharing to address insider trading and fraud in prediction markets. The NBA joins Major League Baseball and the National Hockey League in establishing similar arrangements with the regulator.
Related: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
States challenge federal oversight of prediction markets
The NBA’s agreements come amid an ongoing legal battle over whether federal commodities rules supersede state gambling laws governing sports prediction markets.
The dispute has produced conflicting court decisions. In September, the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi in a case involving Ohio and Tennessee, following a similar decision by the 9th Circuit. An earlier ruling by the 3rd Circuit, however, allowed Kalshi to continue operating in New Jersey while its appeal proceeds.
State enforcement actions have continued. On Oct. 20, Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi, alleging that the platform had facilitated illegal betting in the state since 2024. Utah officials are seeking to recover an estimated $30 million to $60 million in profits allegedly earned by Kalshi and other defendants.
Kalshi event contract. Source: Kalshi
The US Supreme Court has been asked to review the New Jersey dispute, with 39 states and Washington, DC, supporting the petition. The National Football League, which has not entered into commercial partnerships with prediction market exchanges, also backed the petition, arguing that certain sports event contracts threaten game integrity because they are susceptible to manipulation. The justices have not yet agreed to hear the case.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Bitcoin wallet Electrum released version 4.8.3 on October 24 with a patch for a high-severity exploit that let malicious servers inject fake transactions and trick users into paying attacker addresses.
- At least one user confirmed losing funds on October 18 after fee-bumping a server-manipulated transaction.
- The fix verifies signatures on wallet-owned inputs before displaying unconfirmed transactions, but incoming transactions from external senders remain unverified.
Bitcoin wallet Electrum patched a high-severity vulnerability this weekend that allowed rogue servers to manipulate pending Bitcoin transactions and redirect funds to attacker-controlled addresses. The flaw affects all versions before 4.8.3, which is now available.
At least one user has confirmed losing money to the exploit.
Electrum is one of the oldest Bitcoin software wallets around. The attack exploits the wallet’s trust model for unconfirmed transactions. When a user broadcasts a payment through a compromised server, the server can suppress the real transaction and inject a fake conflicting one—showing an attacker’s output address and zero fee, making the payment look stuck.
Because Electrum doesn’t verify signatures on unconfirmed transactions from the server, the spoofed transaction appears in the wallet’s history as legitimate.
When the user fee-bumps what looks like a stalled payment, they sign and broadcast a completely new valid transaction—one whose output address belongs to the attacker. The real payment was never sent; the fee-bump is the first transaction that actually hits the network, and it pays the attacker.
Electrum developer SomberNight, who published the advisory, noted that attackers can grind the fake transaction’s output address to match the last four characters of the user’s intended destination. Anyone spot-checking only the tail of a long Bitcoin address would see an apparent match.
The advisory states that “some servers are performing this attack in the wild,” backed by two user reports. A user identified as dannydeezy first flagged the suspicious server behavior on October 11; the manipulated transaction never propagated past the local server, so no funds were lost. A second user, Raju-K12, reported a confirmed loss on October 18 after fee-bumping a manipulated transaction.
The patch in 4.8.3 closes the main attack surface by verifying cryptographic signatures on wallet-owned inputs before adding any unconfirmed transaction to local history. A server can no longer inject a fake transaction touching the user’s own addresses without providing valid signatures—which the attacker cannot forge. The fix was tagged in the repository on October 23 and binaries were published the following day.
Incoming transactions from external senders—where none of the inputs belong to the user’s wallet—are still accepted without signature verification. SomberNight acknowledged this gap in the advisory, noting it would require additional work to close.
This isn’t Electrum’s first rodeo and it has dealt with malicious attacks in the past. A 2018 campaign used rogue servers to push fake update notifications, and by 2020 it had drained an estimated $25 million from Electrum users. Electrum’s open server model—anyone can run a node—is what makes this class of attack possible.
Users who connect exclusively to a server they run themselves are not affected. Anyone who cannot update immediately should manually verify output addresses and amounts before signing any transaction; Electrum 4.8.3 is available at electrum.org alongside the project’s Github.

Payward, the parent company of Kraken, announced its intention to be the first CFTC-regulated deployer on HIP-3* markets. Payward will use Hyperliquid as the infrastructure layer to deploy perpetual futures markets for US clients. Subject to regulatory approval, Bitnomial, Payward’s CFTC-regulated DCM and DCO, would act as the HIP-3* deployer: creating, owning, and administering the markets and clearing and settling the contracts. If approved, NinjaTrader Clearing, Payward’s CFTC-registered FCM, would carry client accounts.

HIP-3 will support optional deployer configuration for permissioned markets in a future network upgrade. This set of additional deployer functionality is collectively called HIP-3*. At its core, HIP-3* activation involves an onchain allowlist managed by the deployer or its sub-deployers. The functionality is strictly additive to HIP-3; its use is optional and up to the deployer. Existing markets remain unchanged. The initial release is available on testnet, where specifications are preliminary and subject to change based on feedback.

Hyperliquid is a neutral infrastructure layer with the goal of supporting large parts of the financial system. HIP-3* gives deployers additional functionality to operate deployments consistent with the requirements applicable to them. As with HIP-3, HIP-3* deployers are independent operators who use Hyperliquid as the onchain infrastructure layer for their own markets, while retaining control and responsibility over their deployment.

苹果：注意到少量iPhone Duo存在内屏故障，建议办理换机

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，据 BIT（Bit.com）行情数据，苹果美股现跌 1.02%，市值暂报 5.02 万亿美元。苹果发文表示，已经注意到少量 iPhone Duo 存在内屏故障，建议用户联系 AppleCare 办理换机。

苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 自 10 月 23 日在主要市场上市后，陆续出现铰链附近屏幕破损问题。用户上传的照片显示，部分设备的屏幕从铰链中央出现白色射线状裂痕，并延伸至屏幕右下方。

业内人士认为，缺陷集中出现在铰链同一位置，可能与铰链设计有关，苹果或不得不重新设计相关结构。报道称，苹果在研发阶段就面临铰链供应问题，原定第一供应商美国安费诺因生产良率不及预期，供应地位被台湾新日兴取代，但后者同样面临生产困难，曾通过筛选符合标准的「黄金样品」供货。

苹果此前称，iPhone Duo 的铰链包含 100 多个零部件，并采用 3D 打印铰链模组。由于产品已进入量产阶段，苹果可能需要通过减少铰链组件等方式，在尽量缩小设计改动的同时解决缺陷。

报道指出，铰链问题可能影响产品交付及销售表现。苹果据称向供应商提供的预期显示，截至今年年底，iPhone Duo 完整机产能对应的零部件供应量约为 600 万台。另据报道，零部件供应商 Fine M-Tec 已声明，近期相关产品质量问题与其供应的零部件组装无关。

NBA与CFTC签署预测市场监管协议，Kalshi和Polymarket成首选合作平台

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）与美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）签署谅解备忘录，双方将共享信息、建立沟通机制，以维护预测市场交易的公平性，防范内幕交易和市场操纵。NBA 同时宣布，Kalshi 和 Polymarket 将成为其首选预测市场平台。

NBA 成为第三个与 CFTC 签署类似协议的美国职业体育联盟。此前，美国国家冰球联盟（NHL）和美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）已与 CFTC 达成合作。

预测市场监管权限仍存在争议。CFTC 认为，多数预测市场合约属于掉期产品，受其专属管辖；多个州则认为相关平台涉嫌违反州博彩法律。新泽西州已请求美国最高法院审理相关争议，NFL 也提交法庭之友意见，主张体育预测合约属于博彩，应由各州监管。

此外，预测市场内幕交易问题持续受到关注。Kalshi 和 Polymarket 均表示，已采取措施加强敏感市场交易者的身份及就业信息核验，以降低利用非公开信息交易的风险。

Bernstein下调Coinbase目标价至250美元，上调Robinhood与Circle预期

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，Bernstein 在最新研报中维持 Coinbase、Robinhood 和 Circle 的「跑赢大盘」评级，但调整了三家公司的业绩预测与目标价。随着加密货币现货交易增长放缓，预测市场、衍生品及代币化业务正成为相关公司的新增长引擎。

Coinbase 方面，Bernstein 将目标价从 330 美元下调至 250 美元，并将 2026 年营收预期下调约 32% 至 55 亿美元，预计全年每股亏损 2.60 美元，此前预期为每股盈利 5.97 美元。该机构预计，Coinbase 的预测市场和衍生品业务到 2028 年可创造约 20 亿美元收入，高于年初预估的约 6 亿美元。

Robinhood 方面，Bernstein 维持 160 美元目标价，预计其预测市场业务 2028 年收入将达到 17 亿美元，略高于同期加密业务预期的 16 亿美元。该机构预计，公司第三季度事件合约交易量环比增长 21% 至约 164 亿份；7 月上线的自有区块链第三季度交易量约 900 亿美元，产生约 5000 万美元手续费。

Circle 方面，Bernstein 将目标价从 140 美元上调至 145 美元，预计第三季度营收将小幅升至 7.7 亿美元。尽管 USDC 流通量从第二季度的约 770 亿美元降至约 730 亿美元，储备收入预计承压，但 Arc 代币预售及未来交易手续费、验证者质押收入有望提供新的增长来源。

items.author: Guillermo Jimenez
items.content:
In brief
- CoinDCX confirmed it lost 15.99 million USDT (~$16 million) after an internal process failed to sweep customer deposits out of wallets it retired following a 2025 hack.
- The admission reversed CEO Sumit Gupta’s earlier claim that breach reports were a “false alarm.”
- It brings CoinDCX’s losses across two incidents to nearly $60 million, following the roughly $44 million hack last year.
Indian crypto exchange CoinDCX has admitted it lost about $16 million in an attack on its wallet infrastructure, reversing its co-founder’s earlier insistence that reports of a breach were a “false alarm.”
In a blog post, the Mumbai-based exchange said 15.99 million USDT was drained and that it has absorbed the loss itself, stressing that customer funds remain safe.
The money moved on the Tron network on Oct. 21, and the company traced the incident to a failure in an internal process meant to sweep customer deposits out of wallets it had retired after a far larger hack last year.
The disclosure caps an awkward few days for the exchange. When blockchain researchers and the Arkham tracker first flagged roughly $16 million in suspicious outflows, CEO Sumit Gupta pushed back on X, writing that CoinDCX’s wallets were “not breached” and that the flagged addresses had been compromised back in July 2025, making the activity look like “a false alarm.”
On-chain investigator ZachXBT disputed that account, noting the wallet in question had still been sweeping user deposits into CoinDCX’s current hot wallet as recently as April and May, and he urged customers to withdraw their assets.
Withdraw all funds from CoinDCX if you value your assets.
Its co-founders are clowns running a circus.
They publicly and privately denied a theft of its assets occurred meaning they straight up lied or are negligently incompetent.
Later they disclosed the $16M theft and… pic.twitter.com/uEmtogPonq
— ZachXBT (@zachxbt) October 22, 2026
The loss compounds a tumultuous stretch for one of India’s largest exchanges. CoinDCX suffered a roughly $44 million hack in July 2025 that it blamed on a server breach, prompting a bounty hunt for the stolen funds and, later, the arrest of an employee over the incident.
Together, the two episodes bring the exchange’s losses to nearly $60 million.
The retired wallets at the center of the new loss were themselves a legacy of that earlier breach, addresses the exchange had stopped using but which kept receiving residual deposits. The failure of an automated transfer system to clear them out left the funds exposed.
CoinDCX has weathered other turbulence this year. The exchange faced fraud and impersonation-scam allegations that drew a police probe, while its founder denied reports of acquisition talks with Coinbase following the 2025 hack. Coinbase has separately moved to expand across South Asia and the Middle East.
The exchange said it would share further details as its investigation continues, and reiterated that user balances are unaffected.

items.ai_reason: A lab (Cohere) disclosing a rare, concrete misbehavior finding in a widely used open-weight model is useful AI-safety signal, but the observed behavior occurred in fewer than 1 in 100,000 calls and disappeared on re-run, so it is neither a frontier-model release nor a major incident. The HN thread (132 points, 47 comments) is substantive and skeptical — commenters question dataset-poisoning as an unavoidable root cause, note Cohere's incentive to push a policy narrative, and point to similar failures in closed models — but discussion stays at opinion level rather than producing new evidence.
items.ai_summary: Cohere published an analysis documenting a rare concerning output from a popular open-weight AI model — occurring in fewer than one call in 100,000 and not reproducing on a clean re-run — arguing for stronger sandboxing and guardrails around deployed models.
items.author: matthieu_bl
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[orbital-decay]: By that logic you can't trust  any  model, neither trained by Cohere nor trained by yourself from scratch, because it's pretrained on public data that might easily be poisoned on purpose, and it's impossible to ensure 100% safety of your post-training set either. Which is not wrong and it's not even a hypothetical, a ton of people are constantly trying to poison the web in novel ways and feed it to your crawler. That's just the reality of working with gigantic dataset...

[hmokiguess]: Cohere has a lot more to gain from pushing this narrative than anybody else. Looks like they're moving towards a policy maker rather than an innovation lab these days, which is quite sad.

[throwa356262]: So it begins. First Chinese providers were evil and should not be trusted, next Chinese models are dangerous and must be avoided. I had a closed LLM push a sensitive local project to a github repo for the world to see in direct violation of my instructions. LLMs are dumb and unpredictable, run them enough times and at least one instance will do something stupid and dangerous.

[armcat]: > The behavior is rare: less than one call in 100,000 across our evaluation runs, and a clean re-run of the same prompt produced a textbook detection rule as desired. It's great that they caught this as it highlights the need for better sandboxing and guardrails. Not sure if this was bad intent from the model - the rarity of it feels more like some residue in the training data.

[metalcrow]: > a weight file you can’t trust is still a black box Important to note, LLMs are still black boxes even if you use a more open source model, I.e open training data or even if you train it yourself!

items.author: Jacob Lyon
items.content:
Crypto traders are boycotting the memecoin platform Pump Fun this week over the firm’s lack of airdrop, numerous rug pulls, and its chaotic token launch with the crypto trader Kimchi.
Users across X have been sharing the “BOYCOTTPUMPFUN” hashtag, along with its own graphic, in an attempt to hold Pump Fun accountable for the “worst month ever in the trenches.”
One of the earliest examples of the boycott graphic was shared by the crypto X user ‘RonPull’ last Friday.
Read more: Pump Fun’s Kimchi partnership has turned into chaos
Another boycotter, the crypto trader and influencer Jack Duval, revealed on Sunday that he was starting a movement to “tank” Pump Fun’s revenue until the company releases an airdrop.
It’s been 474 days since Pump Fun teased that an airdrop was “coming soon.”
Duval claimed the boycott would work with just a few thousand crypto traders and that he wants to hold Pump Fun accountable for using “misleading marketing tactics to lure in new participants and artificially increase trading volume.”
Other users have joined the boycott while complaining that Pump Fun are “money extractors” that is only benefiting itself and the individuals it partners with.
Pump Fun lawsuit evidence resurfaces during boycott
During the ongoing boycott, the crypto X account ‘Crypto Banter’ shared a snippet of evidence from Burwick Law’s second amended lawsuit that was filed last January.
Read more: Solana Labs dropped from Burwick Law’s Pump Fun lawsuit
It showed internal Telegram chats that were leaked by a whistleblower, where Pump Fun’s co-founder Alon Cohen admitted he had created a market for low-value tokens that exposed every user to “really really low odds that come with gambling.”
The evidence resonated with a lot of disgruntled crypto traders who used it to further their boycott aims.
Botched Kimchi token fuels boycott anger
A creative collaboration between Pump Fun and Kimchi, a mysterious influencer who’s built a personality around wealth and crypto trading, also fell flat on its face last week and helped fuel the boycott.
First, the crypto analyst Bubblemaps noted that Kimchi likely only made $6 million trading Donald Trump’s TRUMP token, a stark contrast to the $40 million he was rumoured to have made in claims repeated by Pump Fun.
Kimchi then launched a token on Thursday in a post that was retweeted by Cohen.
Read more: Pump Fun and Kraken delete Hunter Biden $LAPTOP promotion
Cohen later unshared the post, and Kimchi deleted various Pump Fun posts, including the token launch reveal.
Users began to speculate whether or not Kimchi’s account was hacked or if the launch was disastrously handled by Kimchi and Cohen.
Kimchi has since added Pump Fun back to his bio, but neither Cohen nor Kimchi have made any further statements on the incident.
Pump Fun boycott starts right before $2.5M competition
The boycott is taking place during a Pump Fun competition that’s offering a share of $2.5 million to any group that is able to make the most profit trading crypto across a two-week period.
However, this competition has already been criticized as a means for Pump Fun Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to make more money and is still drawing criticism over the Kimchi incident.

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Anthropic filed on Monday to go public on the Nasdaq using the ticker symbol ANT. Although the public will soon be able to buy ANT and exercise one vote per share, no one will be able to outvote CEO Dario Amodei and six other people who will have 50.1% voting power over the company.
The Claude AI maker’s prospectus explains that seven people are members of Founder LLC, which will own a single share of Anthropic’s so-called Class F common stock at the IPO. Class F stock casts 50.1% of the vote on general stockholder matters.
The filing names these seven people: Dario Amodei, his sister Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Jared Kaplan, Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah.
Reuters reported the existence of Founder LLC in September, but the prospectus formally reiterates its majority voting control.
As if seven was not already concerningly small, it is technically possible for as few as four people to control voting power over Anthropic. Indeed, Founder LLC votes; however, a majority of its members choose, so any four of its seven members control the vote of its single Class F share.
Read more: Viral report alleges Anthropic’s AI safety watchdog
Anthropic warns that Class A buyers cannot swing a stockholder vote or a director election “regardless of how they vote.”
Notably absent from the list of Founder LLC members is Benjamin Mann, who has worked at Anthropic since January 2021. The prospectus concedes he is “often referred to as a co-founder,” yet he is not a Founder LLC member, so he has no participation in Anthropic’s 50.1% voting power.
Anthropic, for its part, says it believes the seven are “distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission.” Public shareholders will be asked to take that on faith, since they cannot change it no matter how fervently they vote.

高盛：美股散户交易活跃度较去年底下降45%，2027年股票供应或创26年新高

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，高盛数据显示，美国散户股票交易活跃度较 2025 年底下降约 45%，散户交易占美股总成交量的比例从去年底的 15% 降至约 9%，接近 2020 年以来最低水平。高盛认为，能源价格上涨、消费者信心疲软及美债收益率走高，正削弱散户买入意愿。

尽管短线交易热情降温，美国家庭上半年仍净买入约 8400 亿美元美国股票，今年以来股票共同基金及 ETF 吸引约 3500 亿美元资金流入。不过，家庭股票资产高度集中，最富有的 10% 家庭持有约 87% 的家庭股票资产。

高盛同时警告，美国股票市场正面临供应压力。2026 年上半年，美国上市及非上市企业合计净发行约 1750 亿美元股权，该行预计，受新股发行及限售股解禁影响，2027 年美国公开股票市场净供应增幅可能达到 2000 年以来最高水平。

随着对冲基金减仓、企业股权供应增加，高盛认为，美国家庭能否持续买入股票，将成为市场能否消化新增供给的关键。该行基准预测认为，若就业市场保持稳定、债券收益率温和回落，家庭股票需求仍有望维持稳健。

items.content:
South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.
Government officials in South Korea are reportedly weighing a delay of the country’s cryptocurrency tax policy, currently expected to be implemented in January 2027.
According to a Monday report from South Korean news outlet Newsis, the crypto income tax could be pushed to 2029 in part because it’s the earliest that officials will be able to share information on taxes related to digital asset exchanges with the US.
The policy, which would impose a 22% tax on crypto gains — 20% from income and 2% as part of a local tax — for investors earning more than 2.5 million Korean won ($1,883) annually has already seen several delays since it was first proposed in 2020.
“We are discussing postponing the implementation of virtual asset taxation,” said an official from the Blue House presidential residence.
The US is scheduled to begin participating in the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework in 2029, while South Korea will implement the rules starting in 2027. A South Korean official reportedly said that the country was considering another delay for the crypto tax as the US “accounts for nearly half of the virtual asset market.”
As of Monday, South Korea’s National Tax Service listed Jan. 1, 2027 as the start date for the crypto tax.
Related: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
items.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，Ritual Foundation 发文宣布，Ritual 主网正式上线，原生代币 RITUAL 同步推出，并已在 Coinbase 开启首个交易平台上市。

据介绍，Ritual 旨在支持链上 AI Agent 自主运行。Agent 可持有自己的密钥，通过赚取收入支付推理、API 调用、定时任务等计算费用；执行节点负责提供计算服务并获得代币奖励，验证者则负责协调任务及结算交易。

代币机制方面，RITUAL 用于支付网络 Gas 费及相关服务费用。其总供应量不设上限，通过持续增发与交易基础费用销毁共同运行。项目方表示，内部人士持有的代币自主网上线起至少锁定一年，锁定期间不可质押。

此外，项目方将向符合条件的 Infernet 运营者、Frenrug 用户及长期社区成员分配 5000 万枚 RITUAL，占初始供应量的 0.5%，并在上线时全部解锁。跨链方面，LayerZero 提供 RITUAL 跨链服务，跨出 Ritual 的代币将在原链锁定，不会因此产生新的代币供应。

In brief
- Brazil’s stock market lost more than $200 billion in value at Monday’s open, and the iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) fell as much as 26% after Lula beat Flávio Bolsonaro.
- Polymarket and Kalshi priced Bolsonaro at roughly 80% before the vote; Lula won 51.79% to 48.21%.
- The dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real, B3 triggered its first circuit breaker since the pandemic, and Bolsonaro said he will seek to annul the election.
Brazil’s stock market lost more than $200 billion in value at the open on Monday after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva beat Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff, a result that prediction markets had priced at roughly a one in five chance.
The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF, ticker EWZ, a basket of Brazilian stocks that trades in New York like a single share, fell as much as 26% from Friday’s close of about $42.60, touching $31.40 before trimming the loss to about 23% at $32.84 by 10:38 a.m. ET.
That is memecoin-sized volatility for a fund built around Brazil’s biggest companies, and it leaves EWZ roughly where it started 2026 after a 34% gain through Friday.
The dollar rose as much as 12% against the real on Friday, while the Ibovespa, Brazil’s benchmark stock index, fell as much as 17% to about 170,000 points. For a dollar-based investor, those moves at their worst combine to a loss of about 26%, in line with the ETF’s low.
B3, the São Paulo exchange, halted trading for 30 minutes after the Ibovespa fell 10% from Friday’s close, its first circuit breaker since the COVID-19 pandemic. A circuit breaker is an automatic pause meant to slow panic selling, but the index kept sliding after trading resumed.
Investors had been positioning for the opposite result since Bolsonaro unexpectedly finished first in the Oct. 4 first round, with 47.03% of valid votes to Lula’s 45.16%. The Ibovespa jumped 7.85% the next day and EWZ gained more than 10% on bets that Bolsonaro would tighten public finances and open the way to lower interest rates. Monday’s drop erased that rally and, at its lows, left the Ibovespa about 11% below its Oct. 2 close.
But Lula didn’t just beat Bolsonaro, he also beat prediction markets.
Polymarket gave Bolsonaro an 82% chance of winning the day before the vote, and Kalshi had him near 80% on Sunday morning. Both platforms are prediction markets, where a contract that pays $1 if a candidate wins trades at 80 cents when traders see an 80% chance.
Polling pointed to a coin flip rather than a favorite, with the latest Datafolha survey tied at 50% each among valid votes and CNT/MDA showing Bolsonaro ahead 50.5% to 49.5% in mid-October. Lula won 51.79% to 48.21%, a margin of about 4.4 million votes, according to Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court.
Bolsonaro said on Sunday night that he does not recognize the result and will ask the courts to annul the election, after pledging in August to respect the outcome. He objected to Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin’s decision to extend voting until 7 p.m. at the request of Lula’s campaign, which he said changed the rules midgame. His own campaign had separately asked for extra voting time in parts of three states.
“It is impossible to recognize the result of the elections in the context in which these things happened,” Bolsonaro said in Portuguese outside his campaign headquarters in Brasília. “We will use our legal team, we will ask for the annulment of these elections.”

items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
items.content:
Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.
S&P Dow Jones Indices has partnered with prediction market platform Kalshi in a deal that will allow the exchange to offer event contracts tied to the financial index provider’s benchmarks.
According to Monday’s announcement, Kalshi will become a preferred platform for contracts linked to S&P DJI indices, with settlement based on official index values published by the company.
S&P DJI will also explore developing indexes using Kalshi’s prediction market data, potentially tracking expectations around economic developments, political outcomes and sporting events. The gauges would use prices from Kalshi’s event contracts to measure market expectations about future outcomes, rather than tracking the performance of traditional financial assets.
The companies did not disclose a timeline for either initiative. S&P DJI did not immediately respond to Cointelegraph’s request for additional details.
Related: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
The agreement follows moves by traditional financial market operators into prediction markets. Intercontinental Exchange, parent of the New York Stock Exchange, committed up to $2 billion to Polymarket in October 2025.
In March, Nasdaq filed to offer prediction market-style contracts tied to the Nasdaq 100 Index, before partnering with Kalshi in August to provide market surveillance technology.
S&P Global completes OpenZeppelin acquisition
S&P Dow Jones Indices parent, S&P Global, separately announced Monday that it completed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, expanding its risk assessment capabilities for digital assets. The deal was first announced in September and financial terms were not disclosed.
OpenZeppelin provides smart contract security audits and development tools. Its open-source contract libraries underpin more than $38 trillion in value transferred, while its security team has conducted over 900 engagements, according to S&P Global.
OpenZeppelin will continue operating as its own business unit under founder Demian Brener, who will report to Yann Le Pallec, president of S&P Global Ratings.
S&P Global has also expanded its digital asset risk assessment work beyond smart contract security. Earlier this month, S&P Global Ratings launched a framework for evaluating crypto lending vaults across six risk categories, including blockchain security, liquidity and governance.

Anthropic估值下限1万亿美元，现金及可交易证券达1316亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，Anthropic 的 S-1 文件显示，公司估值下限约为 1 万亿美元。其 2026 年 6 月 H 轮融资定价为每股 58.90 美元，按约 169.4 亿股完全稀释后总股本计算，对应估值约为 1 万亿美元。

财务方面，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 持有约 1316.5 亿美元现金及可交易证券，另有 25 亿美元受限现金和 150 亿美元优先担保信贷额度。客户方面，过去 12 个月内，年支出超过 10 万美元的客户逾 1.19 万家，超过 100 万美元的客户逾 1900 家，超过 1000 万美元的客户约 250 家。2026 年 9 月，Anthropic 代码库中超过 90% 的代码贡献由 Claude 编写。

股权与治理方面，七位联合创始人合计控制超过 55% 的有效投票权，其中 F 类股份占总投票权结构的 50.1%。公司已向 Anthropic 公益基金转让 8.4684 亿股 N 类股份，占完全稀释后总股本的 5%；董事会还获授权在股价每较此前里程碑上涨 50% 时，额外发行最多相当于总股本 2% 的股份。七位联合创始人也承诺将个人持股的 80% 用于慈善事业。

风险方面，Anthropic 在文件中提示，公司将优先考虑人工智能安全相关目标。上述估值及财务数据来自对 S-1 文件的整理，最终仍应以监管文件披露为准。

大摩将美国数据中心电力缺口上调至38GW，仍最看好英伟达和博通

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Bitmine added 10,452 ETH to reach 6,051,933 ETH, extending its weekly buying streak and nearing its 5% “Alchemy of 5%” goal.
- The week’s bigger move was a share buyback: Bitmine repurchased 2.04 million shares, lifting its 2026 total to 22.9 million shares for ~$399.6 million, which chairman Tom Lee called the largest ever by a crypto treasury firm.
- It mirrors Strategy, which paused Bitcoin buying this week to spend $204.9 million on STRC buybacks—both giants favoring their shares over fresh crypto.
Bitmine Immersion Technologies kept its weekly Ethereum buying streak intact, adding 10,452 ETH worth roughly $24 million, but the bigger move this week was a turn toward buying back its own stock, which the company says is now the largest equity repurchase program any crypto treasury firm has run.
The NYSE-listed firm said Monday it repurchased 2.04 million of its own shares over the past week at an average price of $22.48, bringing its 2026 total to 22.9 million shares bought back for about $399.6 million.
Chairman Tom Lee framed the buybacks as a value play, saying the company intends to repurchase stock “accretively” when management views the shares as undervalued.
The ETH purchase lifts Bitmine’s holdings to 6,051,933 ETH, worth roughly $14.3 billion at a reference price of $2,356 per coin. That’s 4.95% of Ethereum’s 122.2 million token supply, leaving the firm, by its own count, 99% of the way to its goal of owning 5% of the network, a target it brands the “Alchemy of 5%.”
Lee has said Bitmine is nearly finished stacking and will stop buying once it hits that threshold. (Disclosure: Tom Lee is one of several investors in Dastan, Decrypt’s parent company.)
Lee again cast recent crypto weakness as a buying opportunity rather than a warning sign, arguing the pullback stemmed from the same risk-off forces behind a broader AI selloff. He noted ETH had fallen 13% from its recent peak while U.S. semiconductor stocks dropped 20% over the same stretch, which he said was further evidence “a crypto bull market is underway.”
Counting cash, other tokens and what it calls “moonshot” investments, Bitmine’s total holdings stood at $15 billion as of Oct. 25, including 215 Bitcoin, $514 million in cash and marketable securities, a $180 million stake in Beast Industries and a $76 million position in Eightco Holdings.
Bitmine remains the world’s largest Ethereum treasury and the second-largest crypto treasury overall, trailing only Michael Saylor’s Strategy.
Strategy leaned the same way this week, pausing its Bitcoin buying for the first time since mid-September to spend $204.9 million buying back its STRC preferred stock, underscoring how both treasury giants pivoted toward shoring up their shares over fresh crypto purchases.
Bitmine has 5,227,037 ETH, about 86% of its holdings, staked through its MAVAN platform, with projected annualized staking revenue of roughly $318 million.

【以太坊基金会研究员：EIP-8025 执行证明在 Sepolia 测试网实现区块实时证明】

Foresight News 消息，以太坊基金会研究工程师 Tau Lepton 发推表示，其正在 Sepolia 测试网上运行 EIP-8025 执行证明（execution proof）证明者，使用 OpenVM 在 16 块 RTX 5090 显卡上为 ethrex 和 reth 两个客户端程序各分配 8 块显卡，单个区块的证明耗时约 6 至 7 秒，短于以太坊 12 秒的出块间隔，即证明者能在下一个区块产生前完成证明。目前已生成超 3.6 万个证明，未来数天至数周内将轮换测试不同的证明者和客户端程序。执行证明可让验证者通过验证零知识证明而非重新执行交易来确认区块。Tau Lepton 提醒，该功能仍处于实验阶段，验证者不得依赖执行证明进行分叉选择或证明投票，仍需运行执行客户端。

If that's your bar for "impracticality", then sure, this is impractical. But that&...

[darrelld]: I got his book Build Your Own LLM From Scratch and it's super readable and does a great job at holding your hand through the entire process...need to finish reading it though!

items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- X user log4 says he reverse engineered his Samsung TV’s firmware and found a file listing functions including an always-on microphone, automatic content recognition, and targeted ads.
- Cybersecurity experts say AI is making reverse engineering accessible to anyone, meaning more hidden functionality in everyday devices is likely to surface.
- They added that data collection may be one reason TV prices have stayed low for decades.
A researcher found that their Samsung smart TV was tracking them through several functionalities, including an "always on” microphone—and experts warn that similar tools could exist on other "everyday devices."
X user log4j claims to have reverse engineered his Samsung smart TV's firmware and discovered what they call a "privacy horror." One file called 'security-policy.xml’ featured functions including an always-on microphone, automatic content recognition, geo-positioning, network mapping, a targeted ads service, and user profile building, while Samsung TVs without a built-in microphone will look for one on connected devices such as a soundbar or Bluetooth speaker.
But a community note on the post points out that Samsung openly advertises some of these features. Its Pet Care and Family Care tools on Vision AI TVs listen for sounds like barking or crying and alert owners through the SmartThings app.
i own a relatively new (2025) samsung tv.
i kept getting weirdly targeted ads.
i tried reversing the firmware but it was aes encrypted and no keys unless tear it apart and do uart/jtag magic.
zero days it is. root shell on new samsung TVs!
discovered PRIVACY HORROR. write up? pic.twitter.com/EsxxCy1b6a
— log4j (@log4j) October 21, 2026
James Bore, a cybersecurity and technology consultant, told Decrypt that this isn't a new finding but just adding awareness to something that most people weren't aware of.
"The amount of monitoring that smart devices, from TVs to voice assistants to cars, do isn't secret as such, just not something promoted," Bore said. "If you read privacy policies and [End-User License Agreements], it's all in there in almost every case, but most people don't read those."
Jake Moore, Global Cybersecurity Advisor at cybersecurity firm ESET, told Decrypt that this could be the start of a wave of similar findings, as a trend of AI-powered reverse engineering has swept the internet.
"AI-assisted reverse engineering may make it easier and faster for researchers to uncover and explain how devices collect, process, and share data," Bore agreed, "but the underlying collection itself is generally not new or unknown."
Decrypt has reached out to Samsung for comment and will update this article should they respond.
Bore added that smart TVs are monitoring user behavior to advertise to you better and persuade you to spend money. He added that this is "far from unique” to smart TVs.
Moore noted that this might be why TVs haven't seen a noticeable price increase in recent years.
"TVs haven’t really increased in price like some products over the last two decades and that may be because customer data collection is keeping those costs down," Moore said. "Smart TVs are doing far more behind the scenes than most people realise, as many can monitor what we are watching and collect our data to build profiles for targeted advertising."
Last week, smart TV owners started using AI coding agents like Claude Code to strip ads and tracking software out of their sets. One open-source project, Cleanyourtv, now lists tested setups for 107 TV models from 37 brands, though it only fully works on Android-based TVs—not Samsung’s Tizen operating system. However, as one Decrypt writer discovered, vibe-coded solutions can end up backfiring.
Both cybersecurity experts say that the public shouldn't be uniquely concerned about the functionalities revealed on Samsung TVs. Bore said that we should be more worried about how "blasé” we've become about accepting companies "constantly profiling us to manipulate us into spending more money on things we don't need."
"The concern is how much of our data is being collected and who it’s being shared with," Moore said. "It is possible to go through TV settings to minimise the amount of data access points are being used and analysed, but saying that, privacy shouldn’t be something you have to hunt through dozens of settings to find."
Those more anxious about security claim that this form of invasive data collection is enough for them to change their behavior.
Muneeb Ali, the co-founder of Stacks, a prominent Bitcoin layer-2 network, said that he doesn't handle private crypto keys in rooms with devices.
"We were paranoid that a hacked device could record or listen in," he tweeted. "Didn’t realize the TVs were literally 1st party programmed for full-on spying. Only the paranoid survive."

大摩调研：中国企业采购人形机器人要求10万元以内、三年回本

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，摩根士丹利最新调研显示，中国企业对人形机器人的采购意愿仍在上升，但商业化落地节奏放缓，成本与投资回报成为关键门槛。受访企业中，64% 计划未来三年启动人形机器人试点或规模化项目，但各类机器人部署时间线整体推迟约一年。

调研显示，72% 的潜在采购方认为机器人单价需低于 10 万元人民币才具备广泛推广的可行性，高于 2025 年的 53%；82% 要求投资回收期不超过三年，平均可接受回本周期约为 26 个月。

应用方面，制造业和物流仓储仍是主要落地场景，物料搬运、包装与码垛需求突出。不过，企业对现有产品的满意度有所下降，仅 18% 的潜在采购方对当前人形机器人性能表示满意。

品牌方面，宇树科技仍是受关注度最高的集成商，但计划未来三年采购其产品的受访者比例从 2025 年的 60% 降至 32%。摩根士丹利认为，能够证明生产效率提升、满足可靠性要求并实现明确投资回报的厂商，更有机会推动机器人商业化落地。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373796

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes has promoted Ethena (ENA) for years — including repeated $10 price predictions since early 2024 —yet he waited until below $0.20 per ENA to finally admit to selling. On Saturday, he posted his total exit from his investment fund, Maelstrom’s so-called directional book.
His sale post 98% below his profit target certainly makes a review of his calls comically worthwhile.
Just four weeks ago, for example, Hayes proclaimed that ENA was going to at least $1.
Even that would be a good outcome at this point, but unfortunately, $1 is nowhere close to the early price levels that Hayes espoused.
Around the time his doomed promotions began, Hayes wrote, “$ENA = $10” on April 2, 2024.
He promised the next day, “the Koreans aren’t even involved yet,” and urged followers, “count to $10 for $ENA.”
On May 7, 2024, he repeated his prediction that ENA somehow rally to $10. On May 25, he taunted doubters doubting ENA, “Cope harder.”
That June 20, he called ENA “an integral part of the CeFi and DeFi trading ecosystem.” Its price has declined by two-thirds since.
In September 2024, his Token2049 conference speech reiterated that he remained heavily invested in ENA.
On December 6, with ENA trading near $1, he doubled down on his $10 forecast.
Arthur Hayes continued to inaccurately predict a rally for ENA
The turn of the year into 2025 did not temper his enthusiasm. On February 5, he reaffirmed that he owned “large amounts” of ENA in his investing fund. On July 11, he tried to pump ENA again, “It’s time for liftoff.”
Undeterred on August 13, he predicted ENA would “moon.”
On August 26, with ENA collapsing below $0.70, he argued, “ENA can 51x from the current levels.”
Read more: ByBit insolvency rumors highlight Ethena’s centralization
It was only by September that he dropped his delusions that ENA would rally by quadruple-digit percentages. Somewhat more modestly but still just as inaccurately, on September 8, he forecasted that ENA would rally to at least $1.50. The next morning, he reiterated that price target.
On September 24, he urged his audience, “Buy ENA.” On December 19, he named ENA his favorite altcoin.
By 2026, Hayes’ price target was down 90% from his original $10. It would go even lower.
On January 14 of this year, he declared, “It’s time for ENA = $1.”
After a months-long slide, he posted that it would at least rally to $0.50. On September 25, he tried $1 again, including a reiteration of that call on September 28.
ENA was trading at $0.198 this month when Hayes posted that he had sold all ENA from Maelstrom’s directional fund.

【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】

Foresight News 消息，Akash Network 联合创始人 Greg Osuri 发文表示，Akash 核心团队已选定 Solana 作为 Akash Network 的迁移目标，计划离开其 Cosmos 主权链 akashnet-2，将算力市场重建为 Solana 主网上的原生程序，AKT 将成为 Solana 原生代币。核心团队将在 akashnet-2 上提交迁移提案，需达到 33.4% 法定人数且多数赞成才能通过；提案通过两周后，且在两家独立审计完成后，AKT 将以 SPL 代币形式在 Solana 上发行，同时开放为期两年的单向迁移门户，AKT 按 1:1 迁移，代码和小数位不变，总供应量不变。算力市场的切换时间尚未确定，需在审计和迁移演练完成后由单独的治理投票决定；切换后，现有工作负载将继续运行 90 天，之后旧链停止运行。质押奖励将于切换时结束，验证者角色及收入将于旧链停止时结束。Greg Osuri 表示，选择 Solana 的原因包括不再需要为维护主权链承担成本、交易成本低、Helium、Render、io.net 等 DePIN 项目已在 Solana 上，以及 Solana 的流动性和用户规模，此次评估中以太坊 L2 为另一入围选项。Foresight News 此前消息，Greg Osuri 于 2025 年 10 月曾表示 Akash 将弃用自有链，迁移至能保障其安全的链，候选链可能位于 Cosmos 内部或外部，但均兼容 IBC。

Keystone宣布将销毁1.88万台设备，确认设备验证密钥遭泄露

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，硬件钱包品牌 Keystone 10 月 26 日发布安全事件公告称，其官网于 10 月 20 日遭遇安全事件。攻击者利用网站使用的第三方数据监控工具漏洞提升权限，获取部分客户信息及用于验证设备真伪的密钥。

此次事件涉及官网 Shopify 商店的 51,083 条购买记录，其中 25,964 条仍包含个人信息，涉及 2024 年至 2026 年的客户姓名、联系方式、收货地址及订单信息。此外，还有 12,873 条未完成付款的结账记录包含用户提交的个人信息。通过亚马逊及其他销售渠道购买的客户记录未受影响。

Keystone 表示，攻击者获取的设备认证密钥可能被用于制造能够通过真伪验证的假冒设备，但事件未涉及助记词、钱包私钥或其他钱包凭证，也未涉及银行支付信息及政府签发的身份证件号码。

作为应对措施，Keystone 将停用旧认证密钥，销毁库存中使用旧密钥的 18,835 台设备，并暂停官网未发货订单的配送，待采用新密钥的设备投产后恢复发货。公司同时将客户个人信息的保留期限从 180 天缩短至 90 天，并已向 Shopify 提交数据删除申请，预计于 11 月 3 日完成相关删除流程。

Keystone 提醒，10 月 20 日之后收到且使用旧认证密钥的设备，即使通过认证，也无法完全排除假冒风险，用户应联系官方客服进一步核验。公司强调，用户无需仅因本次事件转移资产，并警惕以资产迁移、钱包验证或设备召回为由实施的诈骗。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373792

加拿大就稳定币监管草案征求意见，继续禁止发行方支付利息

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，加拿大财政部启动为期 60 天的稳定币监管草案公众咨询，截止日期为 12 月 23 日。草案继续禁止稳定币发行方直接或通过第三方支付持币利息，但允许与交易行为挂钩的奖励。

根据草案，非银行稳定币发行方必须以等值储备资产对流通中的法币锚定稳定币进行 1:1 支持，并将储备存放于符合条件的加拿大金融机构，包括银行、信用合作社和信托公司。用户赎回稳定币应在 3 个工作日内完成，赎回费用不得超过 1%。

加拿大此前已通过《稳定币法案》，此次监管细则旨在明确发行方向加拿大央行注册所需满足的要求。相关框架预计于 2027 年底前后生效。

该草案出台之际，加拿大银行业正推动禁止稳定币支付收益，以防资金从传统银行存款流向稳定币。与此同时，加拿大部分加密平台已获准向符合条件的稳定币持有者提供收益。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.
Internet users are still vulnerable to cyber exploits stemming from the PHP vulnerability, particularly through smaller websites that could take weeks to adopt the upgrade shipped last Wednesday, according to bug bounty platform Immunefi CEO Mitchell Amador.
“This is the vulnerability apocalypse” running on schedule, where finding vulnerabilities became cheap, but fixing them remains expensive, Amador told Cointelegraph.
“For the next few weeks, treat any site you log into as if it could already be compromised,” said Amador, warning users to avoid reusing passwords and to exercise caution when connecting their cryptocurrency wallets to websites. He also urged users to revoke unrecognized token approvals.
The comments come nearly a week after the PHP Foundation acknowledged that it delayed fixing a critical security flaw first identified in 2024, due to a shortage of resources. PHP developers released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities on the same day, but websites still need to independently upgrade.
In an interview published by Cointelegraph in June, Amador warned that the proliferation of frontier AI models changed the cybersecurity playing field in favor of attackers, causing a “vulnerability apocalypse” that led to the resurgence in decentralized finance (DeFi) hacks.
Percentage of programs with a confirmed critical vulnerability by time live. 
Source: Immunefi
Immunefi is the world’s largest bug bounty platform that paid out $140 million in bounties across 650 protocols to date, according to its homepage.
Related: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
PHP flaw drew millions of exploit attempts within hours
According to Cloudflare’s CEO Matthew Prince, the network saw millions of exploit attempts in the 24 hours after the PHP vulnerabilities were publicly revealed and thousands of attempts even before their disclosure, he wrote a Thursday X post.
About one in five websites worldwide routes traffic through Cloudflare, according to the internet infrastructure company, which helps websites load faster and protect users from cyber threats.
Research service W3Techs estimates that PHP powers about 69% of websites with a known server-side programming language. The vulnerabilities may allow attackers to spread malware or inject malicious scripts into websites around the world.
The FBI’s Cyber Division also warned that the vulnerabilities may allow malicious actors to “remotely execute code in PHP core, potentially compromising sensitive data and networks,” according to a Wednesday X post.
Magazine: How a ‘Wrong Number’ message turned into a $3.4M crypto scam

Anthropic财务数据引社区看多浪潮：收入半年暴增15倍，效率与现金流双改善

2026 年上半年收入达 163 亿美元，较上年同期约 11–12 亿美元增长约 14–15 倍；第三季度单季收入进一步升至 168 亿美元，环比增长约 45%。知名科技投资人 Peter Diamandis 指出，亚马逊、谷歌、苹果分别用了 21 年、10 年、20 年才达到年入 160 亿美元规模，而 Anthropic 仅用半个财年即实现。

同时，单位算力效率显著提升：每投入 1 美元算力现可产生约 2.08 美元收入（较此前大幅改善）。部分分析显示，上半年自由现金流已转正（约 34 亿美元），调整后盈利与高净收入留存率（约 900%）进一步增强信心。企业客户质量也被看好，年付费超 10 万美元客户已超 1.19 万家。

看多派强调，尽管账面出现 807 亿美元净亏损，但其中大部分为非现金会计调整，实际运营表现远好于「烧钱」叙事。随着 Claude 等产品加速企业采用，市场正重新评估 Anthropic 的长期增长潜力。

【Miden 上线合作伙伴主网，计划数月内过渡至公开主网】

Foresight News 消息，零知识证明公链 Miden 创始人 Bobbin Threadbare 发推表示，Miden 合作伙伴主网（Partner Mainnet）已面向合作伙伴和受邀用户开放。合作伙伴主网支持客户端证明，大多数交易可在移动设备上 3 秒内完成证明；账户可由守护者（Guardian）机制保护；交易手续费可使用稳定币 USDCx 支付；支持通过 Circle xReserve、AggLayer、NEAR Intents 和 Epoch 等桥与多条链互通，并内置协议级 DEX，用户可通过 Bread 钱包使用。Bobbin Threadbare 表示，合作伙伴主网初期设有安全限制，验证者会收集用户的私密交易输入以验证零知识证明，并对交易细节进行门限加密存储，以便在黑客攻击等特殊情况下解密特定交易。Miden 计划在几个月内过渡至公开主网，届时将把哈希函数由 Poseidon2 切换为基于 Blake3 的方案、改进手续费模型，并加强区块级证明；此后将逐步推进去中心化并取消上述安全限制。

特朗普家族关联加密及投资企业提前备战，防范民主党中期选举后调查

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据彭博社报道，随着美国中期选举临近、民主党夺回国会至少一个议院的可能性上升，与特朗普及其家族有关联的加密货币、风险投资和预测市场企业正加强法律与游说团队，以应对潜在的国会调查。

相关企业包括特朗普家族共同创立的加密项目 World Liberty Financial、预测市场平台 Polymarket 和 Kalshi、赵长鹏以及风险投资机构 1789 Capital 等。部分企业已聘请知名律师和游说人士，其中一些与民主党议员存在联系。

民主党此前已要求 World Liberty Financial 和 1789 Capital 提供相关信息，并要求司法部说明币安联合创始人赵长鹏获得特朗普赦免一事。民主党议员表示，若取得国会多数席位，将利用调查和传票权审查特朗普家族商业利益与政府政策之间是否存在利益冲突，包括企业是否获得政府合同或其他特殊待遇。

报道指出，相关调查仍面临障碍，包括部分证据和文件位于海外，以及司法部等联邦机构是否采取进一步行动存在不确定性。涉事企业则坚称其商业活动符合法律规定。

CZ：BNB Chain每日用户超300万，BNC将把BNB生态带入华尔街

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，Binance 创始人 CZ 今日在 BNB Standard Corporation（BNC）纳斯达克敲钟仪式上表示，BNB 从 2017 年推出时的简单代币，发展至今已成为拥有独立区块链的生态系统。BNB Chain 每月服务约 3000 万用户，每日用户超过 300 万，是全球最活跃的区块链之一，也是现实世界资产（RWA）流动性最高的区块链之一。

CZ 表示，BNB Chain 出块时间约为 0.5 秒，交易最终确认时间不到 1 秒。过去多个市场周期中，BNB 生态持续建设基础设施，并拓展支付、借贷和投资等领域，未来希望成为用户储蓄、转账和构建应用的平台。

BNC 方面则表示，公司将把 BNB 带入华尔街。作为一家以 BNB 为资产负债表核心的纳斯达克上市公司，BNC 不仅计划持有 BNB，还将围绕 BNB Chain 发展运营业务，首先运行自己的验证节点，并逐步扩大业务规模。

数据：Binance及Binance.US稳定币储备占比升至近75%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 27 日，据 CryptoQuant 数据，Binance 及 Binance.US 持有的稳定币储备约占受监测加密交易平台总量的 75%，其余平台合计约占 25%。2025 年年中，这一比例约为 58%，至 2026 年 10 月已升至近 75%。

数据显示，稳定币储备正进一步向 Binance 集中，意味着其在加密市场流动性中的影响力持续扩大。稳定币可作为潜在交易资金，为比特币等加密资产提供购买力，但储备规模增加并不必然意味着买盘即将入场。

此外，Binance 稳定币储备占比上升，也可能源于其他交易平台储备下降，而非资金净流入。因此，后续仍需结合稳定币总量及资金流向，判断其是否会转化为加密市场的新增需求。

items.content:
In brief
- Anthropic has filed to list its Class A shares on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT," with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading the underwriters.
- The company reported first-half 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a net loss of $80.7 billion.
- A trust will elect a majority of Anthropic's board, while an entity owned by its seven co-founders will hold 50.1% of shareholder voting power.
Anthropic, the developer of the Claude family of AI models, has filed for an initial public offering, the company announced on Monday.
The company plans to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "ANT," according to its S-1 registration statement. The number of shares and the price range have not yet been set. Both Anthropic and existing shareholders will sell shares, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley named first among 24 underwriters.
Anthropic has filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC related to its proposed IPO.
Read more: https://t.co/zuRMrxXzNx
Legal disclaimer: A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the SEC but has not yet become effective. These securities…
— Anthropic (@AnthropicAI) October 26, 2026
The public filing follows a confidential draft submitted to the SEC in June. Details of that draft reported by Reuters last month included backers' hopes for a valuation above $2 trillion. In May, Anthropic raised $65 billion at a $965 billion valuation.
Anthropic reported revenue of $16.29 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with $1.16 billion in the same period a year earlier. Full-year revenue was $4.59 billion in 2025, up from $386 million in 2024 and $41 million in 2023.
The company recorded a net loss of $80.7 billion for the first half of 2026. Most of that came from a $72.4 billion charge for changes in the fair value of convertible notes and other instruments, which the filing says was primarily driven by an increase in its valuation. Its operating loss for the period was $693 million.
As of June 30, 2026, Anthropic had raised $141.1 billion in total and held $112.4 billion in cash and cash equivalents, plus $19.3 billion in short-term investments, according to the filing. As of September 30, it had more than 1,900 customers generating at least $1 million in revenue over the previous 12 months, and about 250 generating at least $10 million.
Anthropic's governance structure
Anthropic is incorporated as a public benefit corporation, which requires its directors to balance shareholders' financial interests with those affected by its conduct and its stated purpose: "the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity."
Under the proposed structure, the Long-Term Benefit Trust, a body of five financially disinterested trustees, will elect a majority of the board through a special class of stock. Immediately before the offering, Anthropic will issue a single Class F share to an entity owned by its seven co-founders, carrying 50.1% of the voting power on most shareholder matters. The filing says that makes Anthropic a "controlled company" under Nasdaq rules.
Holders of Class A shares will get one vote per share. The filing warns that the structure "may effectively eliminate the ability of holders of our Class A common stock to influence important decisions, including a change in control."
Anthropic has also contributed about 847 million non-voting shares, representing 5% of its fully diluted shares as of June 30, to a wholly owned subsidiary dedicated to its public benefit purpose. Its co-founders have each pledged to give 80% of their personal equity in the company to philanthropic causes, according to the filing.
The company announced the fund earlier this month, drawing criticism from investor and former White House AI czar David Sacks. "Whether it serves the public good remains to be seen," he tweeted.
Disclosure: This article was drafted with the assistance of Claude, an AI model developed by Anthropic.

items.content:
Anthropic冲刺11月中旬IPO：代码ANT，募资或超1000亿美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 于 10 月 26 日正式公开提交 S-1 招股书，申请在纳斯达克上市，股票代码确定为 ANT。文件包含 87 份材料，但最关键的发行股数、发行价格和目标估值仍然留空。

《华尔街日报》援引知情人士称，Anthropic 计划在 11 月 16 日当周上市，可能募资 1000 亿美元甚至更多，目标估值约为 1.5 万亿至 2 万亿美元。这些数字尚未写入招股书。公司预计再过两周左右，根据投资者反馈更新发行文件。

正式招股书还有不少此前未被充分报道的细节。

首先是新模型对收入的影响。Anthropic 披露，今年第三季度超过 80% 的营收，来自此前六个月内发布的模型。这意味着即便是几个月前的模型，也可能迅速失去收入贡献。Anthropic 还承认，过去曾出现模型训练失败或效果不及预期的情况，投入的算力没能带来相应收益。一些模型也曾因安全考虑推迟发布或限制开放，但文件没有披露新的、具体的延期型号和时间。

大客户依赖正在减轻。今年第一季度，前五大客户贡献约 36% 的营收，第三季度已降至约 21%。同期五家客户各自贡献的收入却都创下新高。截至 9 月底，Anthropic 已有超过 1.19 万家客户在过去一年贡献至少 10 万美元收入，其中超过 1900 家贡献至少 100 万美元，约 250 家达到千万美元级别。

经营现金流也首次有了完整答案。今年上半年，Anthropic 经营活动现金净流入 39.29 亿美元，去年同期还是净流出 15.13 亿美元。虽然账面仍然巨亏，但实际经营现金流已经转正。公司提醒，供应商付款和客户回款的时间变化也影响了这一结果，不能据此认定已经持续盈利。

算力融资的具体条件更加惊人。Anthropic 与博通相关的融资安排允许其未来发行最高 420 亿美元可转债，年利率为 9%，利息不必立即支付现金，而是计入债务本金。这笔钱只能用于特定算力和基础设施租赁。截至 6 月底，相关额度尚未动用。Google 和亚马逊另外分别提供最高 300 亿和 200 亿美元的后续债务或股权融资安排，但实际提款需要满足特定条件。

招股书还确认，自 2025 年底以来，Anthropic 新签或修改的算力、数据中心租赁及采购合同，涉及约 4170 亿美元的未来最低付款义务。部分长期合同最长达到 20 年。

上市后的卖股规则也很特别。创始人以及部分持股超过 0.5% 的大股东，原则上面临最长 365 天的锁定期，其他多数股东为 180 天。不过，公司设计了分阶段提前解禁机制，部分股份可能在锁定期结束前出售。具体可出售数量仍然留空。

此前，Anthropic 宣称七位创始人承诺捐出个人持股的 80% 用于公益。这次招股书补充说明：这些承诺是自愿的、可以撤销，也不构成具有法律约束力的义务。而且即便创始人捐出个人持股，也不会因此失去通过特殊股权结构掌握的 50.1% 股东投票权。

员工则将获得一类特殊的 Class E 股票。每工作满六个月可获得一股，参与股权捐赠计划还可获得额外股份。这类股票没有经济收益权，只能参与部分董事任免和治理事项的表决。创始人的特殊投票权也有终止条件：当符合资格的创始人成员连续 90 天少于三人时，将启动 450 天过渡期，之后相关特殊股票会被注销。

此外，Anthropic 披露，今年 5 月还签署协议，计划向一家帮助中型企业采用 AI 的新设实体投资 3.25 亿美元。公司也明确表示，自成立以来从未派发现金股息，预计在可预见的未来仍不会分红，未来盈利将优先留在公司继续扩张。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.
Michael Saylor’s Strategy refrained from buying or selling Bitcoin last week, choosing instead to spend $204.9 million on STRC preferred stock buybacks.
Strategy repurchased 2.07 million shares between Monday and Friday, reporting no Bitcoin (BTC) transactions or stock sales through its at-the-market offering program, according to its Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said its Bitcoin holdings remained at 848,517 BTC, acquired for $64.02 billion at an average price of $75,446 per coin. At Monday’s US equities open, the biggest cryptocurrency was trading hands at roughly $79,992 apiece.
Strategy’s US dollar reserve remained unchanged from the previous week, at $4.83 billion, Its USD Cash balance fell around 46% to $242.4 million from $447.3 million after management used $204.9 million to repurchase STRC shares.
Since October began, Strategy has spent about $664 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, compared with $72.3 million buying 851 BTC.
The pause came as Bitcoin fell toward $80,000 last week after reaching $84,777 on Wednesday, according to CoinGecko.
Strategy’s common stock (MSTR) fell 2.2% to $142.80 in Monday’s premarket activity, while its STRC preferred shares edged down 0.01% to $99.35, according to Yahoo Finance.
Related: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Strategy bought no Bitcoin last week, its first pause since mid-September, and sold no shares through its at-the-market offering program, according to an SEC filing.
- The company spent $204.9 million of its USD Cash buying back 2,068,459 shares of STRC, its variable-rate preferred stock, up from $193.1 million the week before.
- Strategy still holds 848,517 BTC, while its USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million from $447.3 million a week earlier.
Strategy did not buy any Bitcoin last week, breaking a run of weekly purchases that began in mid-September, as it spent $204.9 million buying back its STRC preferred stock instead, the company said on Monday.
The Bitcoin treasury firm also sold no shares through its at-the-market offering program between October 19 and 25, according to an SEC filing. It holds 848,517 BTC, acquired for a total of $64.02 billion at an average of $75,446 per coin.
Strategy has repurchased $205M of $STRC. As of 10/25/26, we hold 848,517 $BTC and $5.1B of USD Assets. $MSTRhttps://t.co/VQ9soVDIii
— Strategy (@Strategy) October 26, 2026
The pause follows a string of smaller Bitcoin purchases. Strategy bought 267 BTC for $22.1 million the previous week, after spending $21.5 million on 250 BTC the week before that and $29 million in the week it posted a $21 billion third-quarter gain.
The STRC buyback, covering 2,068,459 shares, was the largest of those weeks, up from $193.1 million the week before and $192.4 million the week prior. Strategy paid for it entirely from USD Cash, the pool of money it keeps for general purposes including buying Bitcoin, which fell to $242.4 million from $447.3 million a week earlier.
Its separate USD Reserve, which is meant to cover preferred dividends and interest on its debt, held steady at $4.83 billion. After the latest buyback, $956.8 million remains available under the company's $3 billion program for repurchasing its preferred stock, which it raised from $2 billion a week ago. A separate program to buy back MSTR common stock has $1 billion left.
Strategy and the MSCI rules
The pause comes as Strategy faces possible removal from MSCI's widely tracked equity indexes. MSCI finalized a rule on October 15 that treats "non-operating companies," those whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset, as ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes from the close of November 30. The index provider will publish the list of affected companies on November 11.
Removal would force funds that track the indexes to sell the affected shares. Strategy chairman Michael Saylor had urged MSCI to drop what he called a "discriminatory" rule.

盈科披露币印破产案最新进展：资产出售获批，债权申报截止日临近

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，据盈科律师事务所披露，币印（Poolin）关联债务人的德州矿场资产出售已获美国新泽西州破产法院批准，交易对价最高约 1.8 亿美元，其中 1 亿美元为交割款，另有最高 8000 万美元与后续里程碑挂钩。案件正逐步转向债权确认与分配阶段，债权人的申报窗口正在收窄。

一般债权申报截止日拟定为 2026 年 12 月 31 日美东时间下午 4 时（北京时间 2027 年 1 月 1 日凌晨 5 时），法院拟于 11 月 10 日听证审议。根据美国《破产法》第 11 章及相关规则，依法需提交 Proof of Claim 的债权，未在法院最终确定的 Bar Date 前申报，可能影响债权确认、计划表决及后续分配。

盈科王裕锋律师表示，外国债权人因错过 Bar Date 丧失分配资格的情况并不少见。跨境破产中，「提交过材料」不等于「完成有效申报」。Poolin 案件涉及大量中国用户，债权形态涵盖平台余额、IOU、矿池收益等，债务人主体识别、金额币种对应、债权性质分类和证据格式都可能影响申报效力。

据悉，盈科律师事务所成立于 2010 年，现有执业律师逾 1200 名，是上海规模领先的律所之一。在破产重组领域，盈科入选钱伯斯《大中华区指南 2026》破产重组榜单；在跨境程序上，盈科通过覆盖 104 个国家的全球法律服务网络，具备协调境外当地律师同步作业的体系化能力。（详情可点击下方原文链接查看）

HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.
Bernstein analysts expect prediction markets to become one of the incremental earnings drivers for trading platform Robinhood Markets (HOOD), potentially surpassing its crypto-derived revenue.
Prediction markets could drive up to $1.7 billion in business for Robinhood by 2028, surpassing the projected $1.6 billion in crypto-based revenues for that year, according to a Bernstein analysts’ forecast shared with Cointelegraph on Monday.
The analysts expects Robinhood’s prediction market revenue to increase to $1.7 billion in 2028 from about $650 million this year, accounting for roughly 18% of Robinhood’s projected $9.4 billion in total 2028 revenue.
The forecast comes a day ahead of Robinhood’s third-quarter 2026 report and shows that prediction markets are becoming a growing revenue source for the retail-focused trading platform.
Bernstein expects Robinhood’s Q3 revenue to increase 13% quarter-over-quarter to around $1.5 billion, driven by growing equity notional volumes, options volumes, event contract volumes, along with a recovery in crypto trading volume.
Bernstein raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates by 3% for 2026, 4% for 2027 and 3% for 2028, while keeping its $160 price target unchanged, citing higher equities and crypto revenue assumptions.
The Nasdaq-traded shares were poised to open down on Monday, with premarket activity paring the stock price down to $93.60, according to Yahoo Finance. HOOD stock is down more than 29% over the past 12 months.

In brief
- Bitcoin briefly fell below $80,000 over the past day, touching about $79,330, before recovering to trade at $80,264, down 2.7% on the week, per CoinGecko.
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw more than $773 million in net outflows on Thursday and Friday, leaving October on course for a net loss.
- Analysts warned of further volatility ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision on Wednesday and the U.S. midterm elections on November 3.
Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 over the past 24 hours, as a sell-off in technology stocks and nervousness ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision weighed on risk assets.
The leading cryptocurrency fell as low as $79,332 before recovering to $80,240, down 2.5% over the past week, according to CoinGecko data. It remains about 36% below its all-time high of $126,080.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $635.5 million in net outflows on Thursday, wiping out most of the gains from a three-day run of inflows, followed by a further $137.9 million on Friday, according to SoSoValue. Even so, the funds ended the week up about $301 million, snapping a two-week losing streak, though they remain down about $314 million for October.
Tim Sun, senior researcher at HashKey, said the drop was "primarily driven by a broader correction in global risk assets," with growing skepticism toward AI-related technology stocks a major factor.
"Investors are not necessarily questioning the long-term prospects of artificial intelligence, but rather whether current elevated valuations can be justified by future earnings and cash flows," Sun told Decrypt. Outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs and the unwinding of leveraged positions "further amplified the downward pressure," he said.
Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com, said Bitcoin had come under pressure alongside tech stocks. "Persistent inflation, elevated Treasury yields and expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening have reduced enthusiasm for speculative assets," she told Decrypt.
Bitcoin's key levels
Stephen Wundke, strategy and revenue director at quantitative investment firm Algoz, said $80,000 was a psychologically important mark for many investors, but warned that a break below it could be misleading, given low trading volumes over weekends.
More worrying, he said, was a broader decline in trading volumes as investors pull out of altcoins and park funds in stablecoins. Bitcoin needed to hold the $82,000 level from which it launched rallies in August and September to support the bull case, and staying below it "could see a broader pullback in the coming weeks while the macro uncertainty remains," he said.
"The bull case for Bitcoin is not dead but it is keeping its head below the parapet whilst so many stray bullets are flying across the globe," Wundke added.
Sun said that if Bitcoin falls further, he sees $75,000 as a key support level to watch, and expects volatility to stay elevated.
Hathorn said the Fed's decision on Wednesday and major technology earnings "could prove just as important for Bitcoin as developments within the cryptocurrency market itself." A more hawkish Fed could strengthen the dollar and weigh on risk assets, she said, while "Bitcoin's recovery may remain fragile unless stronger institutional demand accompanies any improvement in broader market sentiment."

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Galaxy’s Alex Thorn argues Bitcoin bottomed in June and is now in an accumulation phase, calling it “an attractive time to buy and hold bitcoin.”
- Bitcoin has closed five straight weeks above its 50-week average, and its market value never fell below its realized value, a first for any bear market.
- Thorn cites $40 trillion in federal debt and 5% Treasury yields as fuel for Bitcoin. Galaxy and Thorn disclose holding Bitcoin.
Galaxy Digital’s head of research thinks the worst is over for Bitcoin.
In a report published Monday, Alex Thorn, Galaxy’s head of firmwide research, argued that Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June and that the asset is now in an accumulation phase. “Our conclusion is simple: we believe now is an attractive time to buy and hold bitcoin,” he wrote.
The call comes as Bitcoin struggles for direction. It traded at around $80,000 on Thursday, 36% below its October 2025 high but 39% above its June 30 low. On Sunday, Bitcoin briefly slipped below $80,000 to about $79,700, according to CoinGecko.
Thorn’s case starts with the charts. Bitcoin spent 44 weeks below its 50-week moving average before reclaiming it in September, and the week ended Oct. 18 marked its fifth straight weekly close above that line. Since 2011, Bitcoin has reclaimed the average after a stretch of 20 weeks or more four times. In each case, the price never closed more than 8.4% below the reclaim level over the following year and eventually regained its prior all-time high.
The halving cycle, the roughly four-year event when rewards for Bitcoin miners are cut in half thereby reducing new supply, points the same way. The three previous cycles bottomed between 777 and 912 days after a halving, and Thursday was day 916. The latest downturn was also the shallowest on record: a 53% drop, compared with declines of 77% to 93% in past cycles.
Onchain data appears to back that up. For the first time in any bear market, Bitcoin’s market value never fell below its realized value, the average price at which every coin last moved. The ratio between the two bottomed at 1.10, compared with lows of 0.56, 0.69 and 0.75 in prior cycles.
Short-term holders, whose coins carried the recovery from $58,525, have an average cost of $74,811 and sit about 9% in profit. Yet the spent-output profit ratio, which tracks whether coins are being sold at a gain, sits at 1.009, suggesting few are cashing out.
Selling pressure is fading, too. Long-dormant coins, unmoved for five years or more, have been sold at about 34,000 BTC a month this year, half the 2024 pace. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have added 87,000 BTC since the June low after holdings fell just 11% from peak to trough while the price dropped 53%, the report found.
Thorn also argued that the macro case has strengthened. Federal debt has reached $40.44 trillion, fiscal 2026 ended with a $1.99 trillion deficit, and the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.31% this month, its highest since 2007. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 sits less than 1% below a record, while Bitcoin would need to rise 53% to reclaim its high.
“A bet against stocks and hard assets is a bet on fiat, the one position that makes no sense today,” Thorn wrote.
The bullish call lands in a choppy market. Spot Bitcoin ETFs swung from a $1 billion three-day inflow streak to two days of heavy outflows this week, leaving October flows in the red.
Last week’s hotter-than-expected inflation data revived bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike, and Bitcoin briefly dipped below $80,000. Higher interest rates lift Treasury yields, the return investors earn for lending to the U.S. government. A bond paying around 5% with almost no risk makes Bitcoin a harder sell, while higher rates make borrowing pricier and strengthen the dollar.
Thorn’s tripwire is a weekly close below the 50-week average, currently $76,540, that isn’t regained within a month. He also noted that Bitcoin “has proven its ability to run to at least $125k, and we see no reason why it can’t retake that level.”
Galaxy and Thorn both disclose that they hold Bitcoin.

标普全球完成收购链上安全公司OpenZeppelin，强化链上金融安全评估能力

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，标普全球（S&P Global）宣布，已完成对链上安全公司 OpenZeppelin 的收购，交易于 2026 年 9 月 17 日首次公布，具体财务条款未披露。标普全球表示，此次收购将补充其数字资产风险评估业务，帮助传统金融机构及链上金融企业评估智能合约和底层技术风险。

OpenZeppelin 成立于 2015 年，提供智能合约安全审计、安全开发服务及开源合约库。公司安全团队已完成超过 900 项审计项目，在产品上线前发现超过 1 万个漏洞；其开源智能合约库 OpenZeppelin Contracts 所支撑的累计价值转移规模超过 38 万亿美元，涵盖多种大型稳定币及代币化基金。

收购完成后，OpenZeppelin 将以独立业务部门形式继续运营，创始人 Demian Brener 留任并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报。公司表示，OpenZeppelin Contracts 将继续保持开源、免费及公开维护。

标普全球认为，随着更多金融资产和资本市场业务转向链上，智能合约及底层技术风险评估将变得更加重要。此次收购旨在将 OpenZeppelin 的链上安全技术与标普全球的机构客户网络及全球分销能力结合，拓展其数字资产风险评估服务。

IOSG Ventures宣布投资Fun，后者为Polymarket等平台提供全球资金通道

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，IOSG Ventures 宣布投资 Fun，押注面向互联网市场的全球资金基础设施。Fun 为预测市场、链上永续合约平台及 DeFi 应用提供法币交易，支付路由和跨链资金结算服务，帮助用户在不同法币、数字资产及区块链网络之间转移资金。

IOSG 认为，随着预测市场、链上交易平台及代币化资产应用扩张，资金能否顺畅进出将直接影响用户转化率和平台增长。Fun 试图通过统一的资金接入层，降低平台自行整合法币通道、钱包、稳定币及多条区块链的复杂度。公司由 Alex Fine 于 2022 年创立。

items.author: Tyler Warner
items.content:
Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors cool over the weekend; BTC at $80.2k
- BTC ETFs close week with $300M net inflows despite outflows Thurs+Fri
- Solana trading bot Bloom was exploited for $947k; team promising reimbursement
- Big week ahead with RH earnings Tues, FOMC Weds and Q3 GDP + PCE data
- Pump announced a $2.5M Squads competition kicking off today and running 2 weeks
Bitcoin Breaks Below $80,000 as Iran Fears Hit the Weekend
Bitcoin slid below $80,000 this weekend after the Wall Street Journal reported Saturday that the U.S. is rapidly evacuating personnel from embassies and military bases across the Middle East. In a Friday memo to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton wrote that “Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel.” The evacuations go well beyond earlier reports of diplomatic staff being pulled from Saudi Arabia.
BTC currently sits at $80,160, down 2.4% on the week. Ethereum fell 3.8% to $2,322, Solana 3.2% to $101 and the broader CMC20 index is off 2.3%.
Over 30 days, Bitcoin is down 4.8%. The majors around it average down 16.5%, more than three times as much. Ethereum off 13.6%, Solana 17.1%, XRP 17.4%, Hyperliquid 17.4%, Dogecoin 22.3%.
There is some positive. Zcash is up 8% on the week while everything else bled, and sits up 135% on the year. Monero is up 37%. Privacy is still catching a bid, in a week when the lead story is governments evacuating people ahead of attacks.
And we have a big week ahead. The Fed decides its next move with interest rates Wednesday at FOMC with Kevin Warsh’s press conference after, the ECB follows Thursday and the Bank of Japan Friday. Q3 GDP and September PCE data land on Thursday, the same day Coinbase and Strategy report after the bell.
Arguably more important than those above, at least for onchain, is the Robinhood earnings call on Tuesday the 27th. Will Vlad and crew address the tokenized stock pushback? Will they mention Robinhood Chain and its memestonk ecosystem? Will they launch a builders grant program? Big questions to answer, and ones that will likely decide the near-term future of that ecosystem.
And of course, U.S. midterms are eight days away. Expect another volatile week…
🌎 Macro Crypto and Markets
- Crypto majors are slightly red; BTC +0.2% at $80.2k; ETH +0.4% at $2,330; SOL +1% at $101.5; HYPE +2% at $77; ZEC +4% at $1,230
- Top alt movers include QNT (+17%), ENA (+5%) and PYTH (+6%)
- Oil -2% at $101; Gold +0.4% at $4,025
- Stock futures are slightly green as oil falls; DOW +0.35%, Nasdaq even
- Crypto faces its heaviest macro week of the quarter with Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan decisions Wednesday through Friday alongside Q3 GDP and PCE, plus earnings from Robinhood and SoFi on Tuesday and Coinbase and Strategy on Thursday
- Goldman Sachs expects global growth to hold broadly stable through 2027 but sees downside risks building from higher energy prices, rising bond yields and slowing AI investment, while arguing that cooling inflation and AI’s growing visibility in employment data mean central banks hike less than expected
- Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna and Intuit joined the companies objecting to tokenized versions of their shares on the OKX-ICE venue, taking the count to 22 in eight days
- Electrum patched a flaw that let malicious servers steal funds from users bumping a transaction fee, after the wallet trusted servers to report pending transactions without verifying signatures
Corporate Treasuries & ETFs
- The Bitcoin ETFs saw $138M in net outflows on Friday; the ETH ETFs saw $4M in net inflows in a welcome reversal
Meme Coin Tracker
- Meme leaders were mixed; DOGE +1%, SHIB even, PEPE -1%, PENGU +3%, TRUMP +2%, SPX +3%, BONK even
- Robinhood chain leaders were mostly green after a bad Saturday selloff; Pons +6% to $160M; AI +8% at $59M; Cashcat even at $90M; GF +85%, Bow +20% and Gage +33% led top movers
- Solana top movers included Launch +50x, Kimchi +70%, Dood +60% and Claudia +50%; Stonk +13% to $133M
💰 Token, Airdrop & Protocol Tracker
- Hyperliquid led onchain protocols in revenue on the week with $14.74M, followed by Pump with $13.76M, Papertrade with $6.67M, and Collector Crypt with $5.31M
- Solana trading bot Bloom said attackers drained about 9,408 SOL worth $947,000 from 49 wallets belonging to nine users by exploiting a third-party module to gain remote code execution, insisting no private keys were compromised and pledging to reimburse 100% of stolen funds
- Pump.fun announced a $2.5M squads competition that will start today and run for 2 weeks, with the top 3 squads earning prizes based on PNL + uPNL
🚚 What is happening in NFTs?
- NFT leaders were mostly green; Punks even at 30.7 ETH, BAYC +5% at 6 ETH, Pudgy +3% at 2.56 ETH
- Identity MD (+13%) and Argonauts (+7%) led top movers

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
万亿AI投资撑起美国经济，但生产率奇迹仍未出现

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 26 日，AI 基础设施投资正成为美国经济增长的重要支撑，但尚未带来明显的长期生产率跃升。经济学家预计，美国第三季度实际 GDP 折年率增速约为 3%，主要受消费者支出和 AI 相关商业投资推动，企业围绕数据中心建设、计算设备采购的资本支出持续扩张。

不过，投资增长并不意味着 AI 已显著提升整体经济效率。目前，美国潜在经济增速仍徘徊在 2% 左右，美国国会预算办公室（CBO）预计，长期潜在增速约为 1.8%。经济学家指出，近期劳动生产率改善尚难确认是否由 AI 驱动，相关收益仍需更多数据验证。

与此同时，美国经济仍面临通胀压力。标普全球数据显示，美国 10 月综合 PMI 初值从 9 月的 58.4 降至 57.6，但产出价格指数升至 59.8，创 2022 年 8 月以来最高水平，显示企业成本压力仍在加剧。

AI 投资能否最终转化为持续的生产率提升，仍是美国经济能否突破长期增长瓶颈的关键。现阶段，数万亿美元级别的投资规划尚不足以证明美国已进入经济增速持续抬升的新阶段。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
调查：79%企业GPU至少一半时间处于闲置状态，70%仍计划扩充AI平台

动察 Beating AI 快讯，VentureBeat Intelligence 汇总的 2026 年第三季度调查显示，79% 的企业受访者表示，其 GPU 算力至少一半时间处于闲置状态，但仍有 70% 的受访企业计划在未来 12 个月内引入、扩充或更换 AI 计算平台。

投资回报评估同样滞后。调查显示，在 64 名计划采用新 AI 平台的受访者中，58 人缺乏经过财务部门审核的投资回报率（ROI）数据，占比达 91%。此外，相关企业在自有 GPU 利用率不足的同时，仍持续通过 API 调用 OpenAI、Anthropic 等公司的闭源模型，导致硬件资源闲置与模型调用支出并存。

随着 AI Agent 普及，多步骤任务带来的 Token 消耗及推理成本进一步引发关注。Gartner 预测，到 2028 年，单个 Agent 工作流的推理成本将上升 5 倍以上。

报道指出，企业 AI 竞争正从争夺算力转向提升资源利用率与控制单项任务成本，具体措施包括将分类、摘要等常规任务迁移至开放模型，优化上下文缓存，并减少不必要的多 Agent 协作。不过，GPU 闲置也可能源于企业为需求高峰预留算力或计划替换旧平台，相关调查数据本身并不能直接证明 AI 泡沫已经形成。
